title: 第7章 第一批名单第8章 暗劲练脊龙形搜骨
content_zh:
;;
“出来了？”方羽一眼就见到了置顶的‘新历60年专升本第一批保送名单公示’，精神为之一振，立刻进行了点击查看。
名单并不长，仅十位。
武陵武道大专，每一届招收学生5000人，每一年专升本名额总共为50人，其中保送名额20人，保送名单分为两批。
每一批十人。
“没有我？”方羽目光扫过名单，眼神微微一黯，旋即又恢复正常。
“也对。”
“第一份保送名单，是根据六月底的大三期末考核成绩定的。”方羽若有所思：“论生命层次，我的排名只是一百多名。”
“但武道技艺分数，我是前十。”
“论年龄，我属于这一届中偏小的。”
“综合来看，我应该是前五十名。”方羽暗道：“原本选上的概率就较小，况且我还未觉醒虚空星相，被第一批选中的概率，很低很低。”
专升本名额。
首先看所有学生生命层次、武道技艺分数，这两者是做不了假的，其次看虚空星相，这代表未来的一种潜力。
最后，年龄也会作为参考。
例如成绩相近的两名武道大专生，自然年龄更小占优势……对于黄金年龄段的年轻武者而言，多修炼半年都会有明显优势。
因此，没在第一批保送名单之列，在方羽的预料中。
只是。
人性总如此，哪怕明知结果，没有彻底尘埃落定时，仍会抱有一丝侥幸的……方羽也难例外，可他很快就已调整了心绪。
“现在。”
“若再来一次考核选定名单，我入选概率要大上许多。”方羽心中很是平静，十天前，他的武道技艺才突破到入微大成。

武道技艺入微大成，在武道本科生中不算少，毕竟，武道本科生，所觉醒虚空星相半数以上是中位星相。
少有下位星相的。
虚空星相的强大，令本科生们借助星力淬炼身体效率更高，加上更多的修炼资源，到大三结束时，生命层次基本都是16级往上走，厉害的生命层次能达到20级甚至更高。
强大身体，孕养更强的精神，感知洞察身体筋骨肌肉束会更容易，且还有更好的武道老师进行指点。
诸多原因，武道技艺提升自然快。
生命层次、武道技艺，两者是相辅相成的。
可大专生不同。
武道大专生觉醒的虚空星相，九成九都是下位星相……星相位阶低、修炼资源更少。
大三的武道大专生，生命层次能达到14级的都少。
加上老师水平更差，以及大专生普遍更不愿努力，因此，大专生武道技艺水平普遍不行。
“优秀本科生和下等大专生的差距，比人和狗差距都大。”方羽暗叹了一声，唯有身处武道大专，才知道大专生能差到什么地步
大专生只是虚空星相比本科生差？
不！
在方羽看来，虚空星相，只是大专生和本科生区别最小的地方……一名学生觉醒下位星相，可只要技艺天赋不俗，又足够努力，都会在高中三年脱颖而出，不至于沦落到大专。
真正优秀的大专生。
通常是方羽这一类人……有不错的武道技艺天赋，却没能在高考前觉醒虚空星相。
“论努力。”
“论刻苦，我自问不比那些本科生差，所欠缺的，是一次机会。”方羽若有所思：“没能觉醒虚空星相？入微大成，有很大希望弥补了。”

"Come out?" Fang Yu saw at the top of the page 'Announcement of the first batch of recommended candidates for junior college promotion in the 60th year of the New Calendar' at the top. His spirits were lifted and he immediately clicked to view it.
The list is not long, only ten.
Wuling Martial Arts College enrolls 5,000 students in each session. There are a total of 50 students for junior college promotion each year, including 20 recommended places. The recommended list is divided into two batches.
There are ten people in each batch.
"Without me?" Fang Yu glanced at the list, his eyes dimmed slightly, and then returned to normal.
"That's right."
"The first recommendation list is based on the final examination results of the junior year at the end of June." Fang Yu said thoughtfully: "In terms of life level, my ranking is only over 100."
"But in terms of martial arts skills, I'm in the top ten."
"In terms of age, I am on the younger side of this generation."
"Taking it all together, I should be among the top fifty." Fang Yu secretly said, "The probability of being selected was very low. Besides, I haven't awakened to the Void Stars yet, so the probability of being selected in the first batch is very, very low."
Number of places for associate degree upgrading.
First of all, look at the life levels and martial arts skills scores of all students. These two cannot be faked. Secondly, look at the astrology in the sky, which represents a potential for the future.
Finally, age will also be used as a reference.
For example, two martial arts college students with similar grades will naturally have an advantage if they are younger... For young warriors in the golden age group, practicing for half a year more will have obvious advantages.
Therefore, Fang Yu expected that he was not included in the first batch of recommendations.
only.
Human nature is always like this. Even if you know the outcome and the dust has not completely settled, you will still have a bit of luck... Fang Yu is no exception, but he quickly adjusted his mood.
"Now."
"If there is another assessment to select the list, my chances of being selected will be much higher." Fang Yu was very calm in his heart. Ten days ago, his martial arts skills had reached a breakthrough level.
It is not uncommon for martial arts undergraduates to achieve mastery of martial arts skills. After all, more than half of the void stars awakened by martial arts undergraduates are median stars.
There are few people with lower horoscopes.
The power of the void astrology allows undergraduates to use star power to temper their bodies more efficiently. With more cultivation resources, by the end of their junior year, their life levels will basically be level 16 and upwards, and powerful life levels can reach level 20 or even higher.
A strong body will nurture a stronger spirit. It will be easier to sense and understand the muscles and muscles of the body, and there will be better martial arts teachers for guidance.
For many reasons, martial arts skills improve naturally and quickly.
Life level and martial arts skills are complementary to each other.
But college students are different.
Ninety-nine percent of the void stars awakened by martial arts college students are low-level stars...the stars are of low rank and have fewer resources for cultivation.
There are very few junior martial arts college students who can reach level 14 in life level.
In addition, the quality of teachers is worse, and college students are generally less willing to work hard. Therefore, the martial arts skills of college students are generally not good.
"The gap between excellent undergraduates and inferior college students is wider than the gap between humans and dogs." Fang Yu sighed secretly. Only when he is in a martial arts college can he know how bad college students can be.
Are college students just worse than undergraduates?
No!
In Fang Yu's view, the void astrology is the smallest difference between college students and undergraduates... When a student awakens to the lower astrology, as long as he has good technical talent and works hard enough, he will stand out in the three years of high school and will not be reduced to a junior college.
A truly outstanding college student.
Usually people like Fang Yu... have good talent in martial arts, but fail to awaken the void star before the college entrance examination.
"On Effort."
"In terms of hard work, I ask myself that I am no worse than those undergraduates. What I lack is an opportunity." Fang Yu thoughtfully said: "Failed to awaken the stars in the void? I have great hope to make up for it by reaching the subtle level."
